hebrewText: הַֽאֲשִׁימֵ֨/ם אֱֽלֹהִ֗ים יִפְּלוּ֮ מִֽ/מֹּעֲצ֪וֹתֵ֫י/הֶ֥ם בְּ/רֹ֣ב פִּ֭שְׁעֵי/הֶם הַדִּיחֵ֑/מוֹ כִּי מָ֥רוּ בָֽ/ךְ

tokens.bdb: to be guilty; by implication to be punished or perish
tokens.kjv: [idiom] certainly, be(-come, made) desolate, destroy, [idiom] greatly, be(-come, found, hold) guilty, offend (acknowledge offence), trespass.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to be guilty; by implication to be punished or perish
tokens.enLiteralWord: to be guilty; by implication to be punished or perish
tokens.explanation: to be guilty; by implication to be punished or perish
tokens.explanationEn: to be guilty; by implication to be punished or perish

tokens.bdb: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative
tokens.kjv: angels, [idiom] exceeding, God (gods) (-dess, -ly), [idiom] (very) great, judges, [idiom] mighty.
tokens.enLiteralWord: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus
tokens.explanation: Elohim — nome hebraico de Deus. Plural de majestade. Denota o único Deus verdadeiro
tokens.explanationEn: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus

tokens.bdb: to fall, in a great variety of applications (intransitive or causative, literal or figurative)
tokens.kjv: be accepted, cast (down, self, (lots), out), cease, die, divide (by lot), (let) fail, (cause to, let, make, ready to) fall (away, down, -en, -ing), fell(-ing), fugitive, have (inheritance), inferior, be judged (by mistake for H6419 (פָּלַל)), lay (along), (cause to) lie down, light (down), be ([idiom] hast) lost, lying, overthrow, overwhelm, perish, present(-ed, -ing), (make to) rot, slay, smite out, [idiom] surely, throw down.
abundance(-antly), all, [idiom] common (sort), excellent, great(-ly, -ness, number), huge, be increased, long, many, more in number, most, much, multitude, plenty(-ifully), [idiom] very (age).

tokens.bdb: to push off; used in a great variety of applications, literally and figuratively (to expel, mislead, strike, inflict, etc.)
tokens.kjv: banish, bring, cast down (out), chase, compel, draw away, drive (away, out, quite), fetch a stroke, force, go away, outcast, thrust away (out), withdraw.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to push off; used in a great variety of applications
tokens.enLiteralWord: to push off; used in a great variety of applications
tokens.explanation: to push off; used in a great variety of applications
tokens.explanationEn: to push off; used in a great variety of applications

tokens.bdb: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
tokens.kjv: and, + (forasmuch, inasmuch, where-) as, assured(-ly), + but, certainly, doubtless, + else, even, + except, for, how, (because, in, so, than) that, + nevertheless, now, rightly, seeing, since, surely, then, therefore, + (al-) though, + till, truly, + until, when, whether, while, whom, yea, yet.
tokens.enLiteralWord: very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb ; often largely modified by other particles annexed
tokens.explanation: ki — conjunção causal e explicativa: porque, pois, que, quando
tokens.explanationEn: very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb ; often largely modified by other particles annexed

tokens.bdb: to be (causatively, make) bitter (or unpleasant); (figuratively) to rebel (or resist; causatively, to provoke)
tokens.kjv: bitter, change, be disobedient, disobey, grievously, provocation, provoke(-ing), (be) rebel (against, -lious).
